Well we do, because, um, we’ve been doing studies in,
for example, serious infections in children –
and we have found that gut feeling is the most powerful predictor
in general practice of a serious infection in a child.
But how do you go about measuring the effect of something like gut feeling?
Well, we asked doctors to record
whether they felt something like gut feeling or an instinct
that something was wrong in 4,000 children,
and then we compared those recordings with
what ultimately happened to those children and we were able to calculate
the diagnostic accuracy, if you want, of gut feeling.
And we found that it is very, very accurate – it’s very useful.
It’s not a hundred per cent right,
